headline: Motherson Sumi Wiring shares rally 13% on strong Q2 results
summary: Motherson Sumi Wiring India reported a 35% year-on-year increase in net profit for Q2 FY27. Revenue for the quarter grew by 47% compared to the same period last year. The company attributed this performance to rising premiumisation, increased content per vehicle, and new model wins. Shares rose 13% following the announcement.
why_it_matters: Strong quarterly growth boosts investor sentiment for the auto component maker.
